title: Analysis code for "Evaluation of Machine-Learning Weather Models in Reproducing Mesoscale Tornado-Favorable Convective Environments"
description:
Analysis code and final figures for the manuscript Evaluation of Machine-Learning Weather Models in Reproducing Mesoscale Tornado-Favorable Convective Environments (Luo, Yuan, Xia, Lee, and Anderson-Frey).

The repository contains the full pipeline from model output data to tornado-relevant convective parameters (CAPE, CIN, K-Index, 0-3 km positive and negative storm-relative helicity, LCPL, PLFC, and the significant tornado parameter STP), the verification metrics (performance diagrams with POD, SR, FB, and CSI; Fractions Skill Score; and MODE object-based diagnostics), and the resulting manuscript figures, including the eight-parameter supplementary figures.

Model-specific inference scripts for Pangu-Weather, FengWu V1/V2, and FuXi are provided under models/, and GFS download and conversion utilities under data_download/. Dependencies are pinned in requirements.txt (Python 3.11.5).
